author: ojiudezue
title: v5.65.0 shipped: Sensor capability vs analytic role (SENSOR-CAPABILITY-1)
summary: Per-entity sensor capability layer: operator-declarable kind/trust/failure-mode overrides (CONF_SENSOR_CAPABILITIES options JSON) with roles derived per query at the consumption site via sensor_role.resolve_role. Byte-identical with no declarations (I1, documented P15 carve-out); provenance channel warded (I3). One consumer migrated: duty-cycle stuck detector — a bed sensor can now be declared 'bed' and become a corroborator instead of a stuck-candidate. Tier 3: 4 framing-disjoint reviews + fix-up + LOW pass. Also aboard: KHOST-1 kanban generator + first live run of the deploy --cards board gate.
